purpose: Pin the partial-class boundary: two partial declarations of one type in one file are recorded literally and are not merged. Each block keeps its own disambiguated identity key (H-007), so one file can never contribute a repeated node id.

not_supported_evidence_kinds.expect: the scan does not merge partial declarations and does not detect that these two declarations are one type, so the two class declarations carry two different identity keys and a caller must not treat them as a merged definition.

expected_distinct_class_keys.name: Widget
expected_distinct_class_keys.rule: two declarations of one type in one file must not share an identity key
